domains.title: Foundation & tooling
domains.description: Root facade, core/runtime infrastructure, command-line tooling, integration helpers, data frames, units, licensing and history utilities.

domains.title: Tensor & compute
domains.description: Tensor representation and compilation, autodiff, compute backends, SIMD/GPU/CUDA paths, sparse operations, tensor networks, fusion and ONNX interoperability.

domains.title: Learning & AI
domains.description: Learning algorithms, AutoML/NAS/RL, SciAgent/RSI, reasoning, neuro-symbolic and causal methods, language/vision/audio/graph components, retrieval/discovery and SOM components.

domains.title: Optimization & algorithm search
domains.description: Autotuning, evolutionary search, algorithm generation, symbolic regression, synthesis and variational optimization components.

domains.title: Algebra & symbolic mathematics
domains.description: Algebraic, symbolic, modular-algebra, special-function, interpolation, fractional and elliptic-discovery components.

domains.title: Numerics, statistics & estimation
domains.description: Numerical solvers, stiff systems, statistics, multivariate/sequential/seasonal analysis, forecasting, estimation, signal processing and Cayley filtering.

domains.title: Simulation & physics
domains.description: Simulation, fluid and thermal models, relativity/nonlocal-relativity experiments, and the ITD deterministic 2-D field-simulation core.

domains.title: Control, robotics & navigation
domains.description: Control and adaptive-control components together with robotics, navigation, battery, grid, HVAC and water-system models.

domains.title: Industrial & engineering domains
domains.description: Engineering-domain crates for machining, metrology, predictive maintenance, SPC, tolerances, fatigue, fabrication, civil/electrical/process/agricultural/maritime/biomedical work, reliability and safety-instrumented systems.

domains.title: Security, provenance & safety evidence
domains.description: Intrusion detection, hash signatures, cryptographic experiments, provenance/digests, capsules and functional-safety evidence components.

domains.title: Data transport, messaging & events
domains.description: MQTT, OPC UA, shared memory and event-model/runtime components.

domains.title: Agent systems & code transformation
domains.description: Agent protocol/CCOS/MCP components, attention-intent handling, scaffolding and code transformation/transpilation tooling.

domains.title: Studio application services
domains.description: SciRust Studio command, schema, registry, runtime, IPC, storage and application-service libraries.

domains.title: Research methods
domains.description: Dedicated research-method crates for prospective dynamic-information analysis (TDI) and deterministic resonant-consensus closure/projection (SRCC).

domains.title: Research benchmarking & evaluation infrastructure
domains.description: Benchmark schema, SRCC benchmark and arena components used to structure or evaluate experiments.
